newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Chicago rebound sparks European feeds trade.
newsitem.headline: Chicago rebound sparks European feeds trade.

text.p: The expected rebound of Chicago soycomplex futures ahead of a three-day weekend in the U.S. sparked some activity on the European meals and feeds market this afternoon, dealers said.
Turnover in soymeal was said to be small, while moderate trade was reported in Argentine sunmeal pellets. A strong dollar kept a lid on activity.

"We saw some business on expectations Chicago futures were ready for a rebound, something most operators already expected yesterday. But total turnover in soymeal remains small as sentiment seems to remain bearish," one broker said.
